How you find problems today

  • Five dashboards Sales, jobs, cash, customer messages and ads, each in its own app.
  • Found too late A slipping project or a spike in complaints surfaces days after it starts.
  • Numbers that disagree Every tool counts jobs and revenue a little differently.
  • No time to look Busy weeks are exactly when nobody checks.

What we build

Built in accounts you own. The agent drafts, checks, or flags; a person makes the call.

  1. One copy of the numbers Your tools feed one warehouse in your account, so the figures agree.
  2. A written brief Each morning: what changed, the evidence behind it, why it matters, and how confident the agent is.
  3. Suggestions, not actions The brief recommends a next step. You decide what to do about it.

Tell us about your version of this

How it starts

  1. 01 A call about one task Tell us the job that eats your week and the tools it touches. We will say plainly whether it is worth building.
  2. 02 Build it in your accounts We set up the data and connections in accounts you own, starting with the tools that task needs.
  3. 03 Run it with a person in charge The agent drafts, checks, or flags. Someone on your team approves anything that matters.
  4. 04 Hand over You get the code, the documentation, and the access. Keep us on for support, or don't.

Built so you are never stuck
